items.catalyst_summary: Year 500 Raffle tasks and global combat-facing buffs should pull broad activity into bosses, dragons, and high-participation grinds.
items.thesis: The official Year 500 Alpha notes add a week-long Raffle of the Century with frequent tasks plus +50 Magic Find and +50 Tracking, making liquid boss-entry items worth watching even when short-term snapshot momentum is quiet.

items.catalyst_summary: Skeleton Key bundles appear in the announced Year 500 major reward pool, increasing attention around dungeon-access utility.
items.thesis: A reward-pool listing can add supply risk, but major-event visibility plus dungeon XP buffs can lift demand around dungeon utility items. Treat as catalyst-sensitive rather than pure market momentum.

items.catalyst_summary: The Year 500 reward pool highlights rare combat/slayer-adjacent drops while global Slayer XP is boosted.
items.thesis: The announced +50% Slayer XP increases slayer participation during the event. Radioactive Vial is a liquid catalyst-sensitive item to watch where market depth supports entries.

items.catalyst_summary: Magma Urchin bundles are part of the Year 500 medium reward pool, making supply and event attention relevant.
items.thesis: This is not a blind bullish pick because added rewards can add supply. It stays in the occurrence list when current Bazaar pressure offsets supply risk.

items.catalyst_summary: Lotus Atoll adds a new post-Bayou fishing island with Lotus sea creatures and progression.
items.thesis: New-island progression tends to pull demand into local creature drops and fishing materials while players build out collections and upgrades.

items.catalyst_summary: Lotus Atoll progression and new fishing creatures keep shard demand relevant beyond raw snapshot momentum.
items.thesis: Shard items often react to new creature/progression metas. Current liquidity decides whether the catalyst is tradable enough for the watch list.

items.catalyst_summary: Lotus Atoll and modern fishing progression keep newer fishing materials in focus.
items.thesis: This is a catalyst-material watch rather than a pure momentum pick. The occurrence score should rise only if current Bazaar depth and sell scarcity support the thesis.

items.catalyst_summary: Harvest/Grand Feast changes affect farming activity and pest-driven rare crop flows.
items.thesis: Official Harvest Feast changes increase event-specific farming activity. Reforge/farming materials can be mispriced when players focus only on short-term price snapshots.

items.catalyst_summary: Harvest Feast creates farming-event attention and rare-crop turnover.
items.thesis: Cropie is a high-activity farming material. The event can add both supply and demand, so current Bazaar pressure is used to decide whether it ranks in the top 10.

items.catalyst_summary: Fossil Essence shop changes list Enchanted Umber as part of the updated mining reward economy.
items.thesis: Fossil Essence shop changes and daily Fossil Muncher demand can change mining material turnover. This is ranked only when current market quality supports the official-update thesis.
